hero.name: Charlie Nozares Boyles
hero.bio: I build modern web applications using Laravel, React, TypeScript and more. I love turning ideas into real projects and solving problems with code.
hero.about: I'm a 4th year IT college student with a passion for web development and technology. I enjoy learning new tools, building useful projects, and continuously improving my skills. My goal is to become a full stack developer and create solutions that make a positive impact.

projects.name: Food Reservation
projects.tagline: A food reservation system with user roles, dashboard and online booking.
projects.description: A food reservation system with user roles, dashboard and online booking. Built with Laravel 12, PHP, and MySQL to streamline restaurant bookings, menu management, and administrative tracking.
points: User role authentication and permissions for admin, staff, and customers
Interactive table and food booking dashboard with real-time reservation status
Automated order tracking and reservation management with email confirmation
Modern responsive administrative UI with live analytics and report export

projects.name: IslaSafe System
projects.tagline: SOS and incident monitoring system with real-time map and notifications.
projects.description: SOS and incident monitoring system with real-time map and notifications. Integrates Laravel backend with React frontend and Firebase real-time listeners for fast emergency response and hazard tracking.
points: SOS and incident monitoring system with real-time map and notifications
Interactive GPS hazard overlays and evacuation center routing powered by MapLibre GL
Real-time alerts and status updates broadcasted immediately with Firebase
Dispatcher management dashboard for incident triaging and status logs

projects.name: TMC-LLM Local AI Model
projects.tagline: Fine-tuned local LLM for TMC knowledge with offline assistant.
projects.description: Fine-tuned local LLM for TMC knowledge with offline assistant. Packaged with quantized GGUF weights to run entirely on local consumer hardware without cloud API dependencies.
points: Fine-tuned local LLM for TMC knowledge with offline assistant
GGUF quantization for fast local CPU/GPU inference with minimal RAM footprint
Offline chatbot terminal and desktop interface with memory and sampling controls
Trained on institutional curricula and documentation for reliable answers
Built and deployed the Laravel Food Reservation platform with full role management and online table booking
Architected the IslaSafe Emergency System connecting Laravel, React, and Firebase for real-time disaster alerts
Fine-tuned and deployed TMC-LLM Local AI Model in GGUF format for offline institutional knowledge assistance
Continuously exploring modern web frameworks, API design, and distributed systems
